pages.title: Breaking Down
pages.text: The first core grown from the lattice does the simplest thing. It breaks. Pistons crush whatever I give it over a lava pool until only $(l:basics/compounds)compounds$() are left. Mob drops leave essences.
Its catalyst remembers violence. Set it down, and the pistons around it learn to strike as one.

pages.name: Destructuration Chamber
pages.text: Pistons face the core over a lava source, a wormhole on top.

pages.title: The Frame
pages.text: Cobblestone, pistons turned toward the core, redstone torches on the walls, glass panes, a lava source beneath the core and a wormhole above it.$(br2)When it wakes, the glass is gone.

pages.title: Its Hunger
pages.text: Bigger things take longer. An ingot costs it 10 DE and two seconds, an ore 40 DE and eight.$(br2)Now and then, once in twenty, an extra compound falls aside where I keep the byproducts.

pages.title: Its Habits
pages.text: I pour things in from above, and the compounds come out the sides. Hoppers and pipes may take them from any stone of it.$(br2)It rests when its shelves are full or its energy runs out. Like every core, it starves without a $(l:energy/wormholes)wormhole$() above it.
